I Never rested on the Muses bed,
Nor dipt my pen in Poesy's well;
But to my Patron's praise I'll bend,
And sing the praise of Drummond's spell.

This is the poem "To William Drummond of Hawthornden" as it is known, written by an unknown author under the pseudonym "M.M." The original source texts have been lost.
